items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 32:1
items.html: For Da'at, Hesed, Gevura, and Tifferet, within the Hassadim, correspond to KHB of the five phases KHB ZON. Therefore their lights were drawn to them according to the correspondence opposite them in the five phases: the light of Yechida is drawn to Da'at; the light of Haya is drawn to Hesed, which is the discernment of Hochma of the Hassadim; the light of Neshama is drawn to Gevura, which is the discernment of Bina of the Hassadim; and the light of Ruach is drawn to Tifferet, which is the discernment of Da'at of the Hassadim. (p. 524, Sub Header, “Arrived”)
